name: Mumble
description: Mumble is a low-latency, high-quality voice chat server (Discord-style voice rooms / channels). This template uses the official mumblevoip/mumble-server image. Private by default: - This template does NOT enable public directory registration. - Optional Server Password (join password) can be used for friends-only access. If you want public listing (advanced): - Edit /data/mumble_server_config.ini and configure the public registration keys (e.g. registerurl/registerpassword). - Public registration requires an empty join password and allowping enabled. Most users should keep the server private.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent data (DB + generated config). Must be mapped for persistence.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Host user id (optional). Default image uses UID 10000 if unset.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Host group id (optional). Default image uses GID 10000 if unset.

variables.name: SuperUser Password
variables.description: Set SuperUser (admin) password. If blank, a random password is generated on first startup (check logs).

variables.name: Welcome Message (welcometext)
variables.description: Message shown to users when they connect (welcometext)

variables.name: Per-User Bandwidth bps (bandwidth)
variables.description: Max per-user Opus bitrate in bits/sec. 96000 = excellent quality. 128000 = near-transparent.

variables.name: Server Password (serverpassword)
variables.description: Optional join password for users (serverpassword). Leave blank for open access.

variables.name: Bind Address (host)
variables.description: Optional bind address (host). Leave blank to bind all interfaces.

variables.name: Allow Ping Details (allowping)
variables.description: Expose basic server status (user count/max). Does not allow joining.

variables.name: Autoban Timeframe (sec)
variables.description: Time window for failed attempts (autobanTimeframe, seconds)
